leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a new Next.js application using the App Router structure
Configure dynamic routes with parameters in the App Router
Implement nested layouts for hierarchical page organization
Initialize and render server components within the App Router
Integrate client components with server components using the 'use client' directive
Manipulate page metadata and SEO elements using App Router conventions
Apply loading and error boundaries for improved user experience
